what: Visual-QA wave-2 rebuild of dune_rock at gameplay scale.

dims.basis: target silhouette from fresh-eyes QA sheets

style_notes: Low-Poly Diorama: chunky, faceted, flat-shaded, palette-only, readable at ~60 px. 1u = 1 tile; player 1.55u; base at z=0, centred on (0,0). Never: plain cubes, featureless blobs, smooth normals, textures, invented hues.
notes: Rebuilt with bmesh parts, bevels, weighted normals, packed UVs.
